:::{#sol-derive-bernoulli-score-deviation}

Write the result using $\devn$ and $\precision$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&= \precision (x - \prob)
&& \text{(previous solution)}\\
&= \precision \paren{x - \E{X}}
&& \text{($\E{X} = \prob$)}\\
&= \precision \devn
&& \text{(definition of $\devn$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
